post.description: Rotation with a 60-second grace: presenting the previous token inside the window replays the same new pair, presenting it after the window revokes the whole family.

Takes the refresh token rather than the access token, so a client whose access token has already expired can still sign out. Always 204: an unknown token must not be a way to test whether a token is live.
The workspace is bound into the access token; there is no X-Workspace-Id header (07 section Conventions, THREAT-MODEL T4). Membership is re-checked here.

post.description: A batch written against an older revision is rebased server-side and applied; the ops that had to be rewritten come back under `rebased`. Two writers who typed different text into the same caption cannot be reconciled by the server, so that is a 409 `edg/conflict` carrying `{latestRevision, opsSince, conflicts}` — never the document. More than 200 revisions behind is `edg/too_stale`: reload.

The server mints the `Resegment` op, so the audited record of what happened carries an id this API can vouch for. Every previous segment id is tombstoned; style, position and `hidden` are inherited by whichever new segment overlaps.

info.title: Aksharo API
info.description: Errors use the envelope `{ error: { code, message, details?, requestId } }` with `namespace/slug` codes (CONTRACTS section 8).

priority.description: Lower runs first; derived from the workspace's plan.

jobKey.description: Deduplication key: one live job per (workspace, key).

attemptId.description: Identifies this run of the job.

creditsChargedTenths.description: Credits in tenths: the hold while running, the charge once finished.

maxQueueWaitMs.description: Milliseconds this job may wait in `queued`.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

jobKey.description: Deduplication key of the failed job.

lastError.description: `{code, message, retryable}` of the final attempt.

worstCaseTenths.description: Credits held in tenths; a replay reserves this again.

distinctErrors.description: Distinct error codes among the pending rows.

dryRun.description: Nothing changed; the counts are a projection.

attemptId.description: The ULID minted for the replay.

attemptNo.description: 1-based: three failures then a replay is 4.

holdReleased.description: Whether a credit hold was actually released.

revision.description: Compare-and-swap counter; one accepted batch raises it by 1.

schemaVersion.description: EDG schema generation (D28). Always 2 in this wave.

hot.description: `EdgHot` from `@montaj/edg` (CONTRACTS §2): meta, media, transcript, canvas, styles.

segments.description: First page of segments, in `seq` order.

nextCursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to `/edg/segments` for the next page.

revision.description: Revision the page was read at.

ops.description: The ops as applied. Empty means the state was replaced (a snapshot restore).

author.description: User id, or null for a worker.

opId.description: The client op id that did not land.

reason.description: Closed enum (`packages/edg` README). Never free text.

message.description: Operator-facing detail; not for end users.

revision.description: The revision after the batch; unchanged when nothing applied.

rebased.description: Op ids applied after a server-side rebase.

revision.description: The new revision the restore appended.

error.description: Present only when the check failed.
